wholeGrains.basis: Oldways Whole Grains Council, 2025 Whole Grain Consumer Insights Survey; 1,500 U.S. adults surveyed May 29–June 6, 2025.

lessSodium.basis: Figure supplied in the pitch brief.

moreProtein.basis: Figure supplied in the pitch brief.

nutritionFocused.basis: U.S. nutrition-focused cup share supplied in the pitch brief.

market.basis: U.S. instant-noodle market size and growth estimate supplied in the pitch brief.

sodiumSample.basis: Unweighted arithmetic mean of whole-cup label sodium for eight selected conventional U.S. cups. Includes each product’s seasoning; not a sales-weighted or nationally representative average. Values are taken from the sourced shelf comparison.
